- **When not to use:** Not ideal for real-time applications with strict latency constraints due to the computational overhead of sampling and multiple surface modeling.
It is designed to enhance monocular depth prediction by incorporating a probabilistic approach, allowing for the representation of ambiguous or multi-modal depth distributions.
This approach is particularly useful in scenarios where a single depth value is insufficient to describe the scene geometry.
